title: Choose the visual world for Cloud Sentinel
question: The roll assigned Airfield Signage. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Airfield Signage
options.lineage: ICAO / FAA airfield sign system: location, direction, and mandatory hold signs
options.thesis: Ground control for three clouds: nothing crosses a hold line without an analyst's clearance.
options.viewport: Top bar, then a composite sign array as the status banner (black/yellow location panel 'ALL SYSTEMS OPERATIONAL' beside yellow direction panels per provider), three provider counters, and Live Incidents / Security Events tables below.
options.risk: Yellow-on-dark can tip into construction-site costume if sign panels spread past the banner, counters, and status chips.

raised.raise: Every provider counter carries the same fixed furniture (count, last poll, connection state) in whole cells, even at zero.
One condensed family carries display and data; structure comes from 1px rules, not floating cards.
Panels snap to one cell module and reflow by whole cells.
Each incident status gets its own sign form (location, direction, mandatory, cleared), not just a colour.
One motion timing for every state change; flat colour only, no glow or gradient.

options.label: Flight Progress Strips
options.lineage: air traffic control strip boards: one paper strip per flight, racked by phase
options.thesis: Every incident is a strip; the analyst physically moves it from bay to bay.
options.viewport: Provider counters as rack headers; Live Incidents as strips in NEW / INVESTIGATING / OPEN bays; Security Events as a dense feed strip.
options.risk: Familiar: strips in bays reads close to a kanban board, which many runs in this category land on.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: The event stream as a pure black-and-white data field; severity is inversion, not colour.
options.viewport: Event volume as a barcode field across the top, provider columns of mono counts, incidents inverted to white-on-black rows.
options.case: Analysts identify with dense mono data, but banning colour costs instant severity reading, so it loses on clarity.
options.risk: Strobing and no state colour fight long-session triage.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Counts built cell by cell on a visible construction grid.
options.viewport: Monumental grid numerals for provider counts over a visible grid.
options.case: Poster logic over triage; analysts don't recognise it as their tool.
options.risk: Reads as a type specimen, not a console.
options.kept: Panels snap to one cell module and reflow by whole cells.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Sections as hued divider boards under acetate leaves.
options.viewport: Tab rail per provider, incidents on punched leaves.
options.case: Rich state grammar, but a manual is a reading object, not a live console.
options.risk: Hue wheel competes with severity colours.
options.kept: Each incident status gets its own sign form, not just a colour.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Findings as registered plates on near-white stock.
options.viewport: Plates per provider with mono credit rows.
options.case: Light gallery sheet suits neither long dim-room sessions nor triage urgency.
options.kept: One family for display and data; structure from 1px rules.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.lineage: illustrated zoo and garden guide maps
options.thesis: Each cloud as a swelling lobe of flat colour.
options.viewport: Three provider lobes with capsule counts.
options.case: Playful leisure world undercuts a security tool's seriousness.
options.kept: One motion timing for everything; flat colour only.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Providers as a ranked roster of characters.
options.viewport: Provider mascots in a ranked grid.
options.case: Mascots trivialise incidents; fails both axes.
options.kept: Every counter keeps fixed furniture in whole cells, even at zero.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark slate SIEM console in the Sentinel / Splunk mould, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Left nav rail, KPI tile row, two tables below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
